title: Kagamine Len — Surrounded By Spring-Colored Sweets〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Whoa...! Look at all the cherry blossoms!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Yes, they're lovely!
In full bloom no less.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
What do you think, Len?
Does this place work?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah! There's cherry blossoms left and right! Miku and the others are gonna love this!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<I really appreciate it, Akito!
I can't thank you enough for showing us this!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No problem. Anyway, when do you want to have this picnic?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Well, we managed to find a nice spot, so ideally before these cherry blossoms fall off their branches!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Got it. I'll let An know that.
I'm sure she's been trying to come up with some ideas for this too.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Alright, why don't we start getting everything together for it while we wait?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah!>
bgm_area00003
Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
This is great, Len.
I'm glad we managed to find a nice spot for our picnic.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Me too! Thanks for tagging along, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You're welcome. I'm also glad that I was able to see some cherry blossoms for myself. I can't wait until our actual picnic.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But we've got a lot of work to do if we're all gonna have fun!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'll see if MEIKO's okay with making some food for our picnic!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: KAITO, can you go find Rin and everyone else to tell them about what we'll be doing?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh? If you're going to MEIKO's place, then I...

rows.Speaker: Len's Voice
rows.Line: I'm counting on you!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. Someone's certainly excited.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Alright, looks like I have no choice but to look for everyone.
The day of the picnic
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay, the tarp's all laid out, we took all the paper plates and chopsticks to the terrace, so that leaves...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Len, the sandwiches are ready.
Mind taking them to the terrace?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay...! Hey, these look great!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. You've been hard at work getting everything ready, so you're more than welcome to sneak in a bite if you like.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: No, I won't... I should wait until we're all together and ready to say, “Cheers!”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. You're such a wonderful host, Len.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
MEIKO, Len.
I rounded up the others.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hello! Thank you for inviting me today♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow! The terrace looks so amazing!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
The tables and chairs are all gone.
There's just a piece of tarp on the ground.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yup! KAITO said this would feel more like a real picnic under some cherry blossom trees.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
So have a seat, you guys!
I'll go see how Akito and the others are doing!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Len seems awfully excited about this.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I know. He even went out of his way to have Akito and the others bring over paper plates and such to give our picnic a more “authentic” feel.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, he did that all on his own?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I prepared the food, but Len essentially handled everything else.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I see.
We'll have to thank him later.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, we should!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I'm back!
They said they're all set!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Thank you, Len.
Alright, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Rin & Luka
rows.Line: Okay♪

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Welcome, everyone!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Thank you for having us.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Whoa...!
Look at all the cherry blossom trees!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I know! They're so beautiful!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I love how the petals are dancing in the air. Len found this place, right?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Yes, that's right.
Thank you for finding us such a lovely spot, Len.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Hehe. We only found this place because Akito was nice enough to show us around.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <So thanks a bunch, Akito!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Anyway, wanna get started?
Everyone, grab your drinks!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <We're all set here, An.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So are we.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright, Len!
Do the honors!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Me? Are you sure? Um...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Here's to all these cherry blossoms blooming on this warm spring day! Cheers!>

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'll get the food out.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Oh, those rice balls are so colorful.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, some are seasoned with green herbs, some with eggs and some with pink starch!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Cool! But why do they all look slightly different?>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: They turned out differently based on who made them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The four of us borrowed the kitchen at Weekend Garage this morning to make these.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <You did?! Oh, now I get it. Was this your first time making rice balls, Toya?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I enjoyed it very much.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, MEIKO, you have a lot too.
Braised foods, fried foods and even inari sushi.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hehe. I made some in advance just for today. However, my piece de resistance has to be my omelets.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I went through quite a few iterations to get the flavor just right.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Nom... Oh, yes.
These omelets are superb. Nom nom...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <KAITO! How many did you just take?!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Quit hogging them! No more for you.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <W-Wait!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I'm guessing KAITO can't get enough of them...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Look who's talking. How much fried chicken have you eaten, Luka? Here, have some inari sushi instead.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <No, my delicious chicken!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Haha.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Haha!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Looks like they're all having fun, and we got to see some cherry blossoms together. I'm so glad we decided to do this!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Len, what would you like to eat?
I'll get you anything from this box.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <You will? Alright, I'll have some Salisbury steaks!>
